compose-config.description: Validate the Docker Compose files (the local services and each application's image build) without starting anything. Part of lint-code, so the Lint leg of continuous-integration.yml runs it. Requires docker compose. Creates the workspace-root .env from .env.default when it is missing (the documented bootstrap; .env is gitignored) and never touches an existing one. Uncached on purpose: the compose file reads the workspace-root .env (env_file), which is gitignored and so cannot be declared as an input, and a cached pass would replay after .env goes missing or changes.

options.command: test -f .env || cp .env.default .env; docker compose -f {projectRoot}/docker/docker-compose.yml config -q && for file in projects/*/*/infrastructure/docker-compose.yml; do docker compose -f "$file" config -q || exit 1; done

hadolint.description: Lint every Dockerfile in the repository (found with git ls-files) with hadolint and the shared configuration/lint/hadolint.yaml, which ignores no rule. Part of lint-code. Requires hadolint on PATH.

helm-lint.description: Lint every Helm release this repository ships with `helm lint --strict`, each chart layered with the values files its Argo CD Application uses. The `helm-releases` command of the deployment project discovers the releases from the chart folders, and helm-render runs it too, so lint and every render-based check judge the same set. Part of lint-code, so the Lint leg of continuous-integration.yml runs it. Requires helm on PATH (the devcontainer installs it; the GitHub-hosted runners ship it).

helm-render.description: Render every Helm release to dist/infrastructure/helm-render/<release>.yaml with helm template, using the values files each Argo CD Application or workflow passes and a placeholder image tag where a chart renders nothing without one. The single rendering that kubeconform, kube-linter, pluto, and trivy-config all consume, so no tool re-templates differently. Requires helm on PATH.

options.command: rm -rf dist/infrastructure/helm-render && NODE_OPTIONS='' node --import @swc-node/register/esm-register deployment/src/deployment.main.ts helm-releases render dist/infrastructure/helm-render

helm-test.description: Run the helm-unittest suites under every chart that has a tests folder. Part of lint-code, so the Lint leg of continuous-integration.yml runs it. install-helm-unittest.sh installs the pinned helm-unittest plugin first when `helm plugin list` lacks it, checking the tarball's sha256. Requires helm, curl, and sha256sum on PATH.

options.command: bash {projectRoot}/install-helm-unittest.sh && for chart in {projectRoot}/helm/*/; do if [ -d "$chart/tests" ]; then helm unittest "$chart" || exit 1; fi; done

kube-linter.description: Lint the rendered manifests with kube-linter's default checks, which include the read-only root filesystem, non-root, privilege escalation, and resource request and limit rules; the version is pinned by the installation project, so the defaults cannot drift. Part of lint-code. Requires kube-linter on PATH.

kubeconform.description: Validate the rendered manifests against the Kubernetes 1.35.0 schemas and, for the Argo CD, CloudNativePG, Barman Cloud, and cert-manager custom resources, the datreeio/CRDs-catalog schemas. Strict (unknown fields fail), and a kind with no schema fails too: nothing is skipped. Part of lint-code. Requires kubeconform on PATH and network access to raw.githubusercontent.com, where the schemas are fetched.

open-webui.description: Manage the Open WebUI Docker service (up, down, open)

pluto.description: Detect Kubernetes API versions the rendered manifests use that 1.35.0 deprecates or has removed. A removed API fails the target; a deprecated one is printed as a warning and exits 0. Part of lint-code. Requires pluto on PATH.

recreate.command: docker compose -f {projectRoot}/docker/docker-compose.yml down -v postgres && docker compose -f {projectRoot}/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d postgres

postgres.description: Start, stop, or recreate the local PostgreSQL container (recreate removes the volume)

searxng.description: Manage the SearxNG Docker service (up, down, open)

terraform-apply.description: Apply a Terraform root (--configuration=openrouter, github, linode, or organizzolini), creating, updating, and deleting what a fresh plan finds. Needs the terraform-plan variables. Run by the Continuous Deployment workflow on main; run it locally only on purpose.

terraform-format.description: Check that the OpenRouter, GitHub, Linode, and Organizzolini Terraform is formatted. Part of lint-code. Requires terraform on PATH (the devcontainer installs it; CI uses hashicorp/setup-terraform).

options.command: terraform fmt -check -diff -recursive openrouter github linode organizzolini

terraform-init.description: Initialize a Terraform root (--configuration=openrouter, github, linode, or organizzolini) against its Linode Object Storage backend. Needs TF_STATE_BUCKET, AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_S3, AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.

terraform-plan.description: Plan a Terraform root (--configuration=openrouter, github, linode, or organizzolini) and write plan.tfplan beside it, without changing anything. Needs the terraform-init variables plus TF_VAR_openrouter_management_key.

terraform-validate.description: Validate the OpenRouter, GitHub, Linode, and Organizzolini Terraform without a backend or credentials, then run the unit tests (terraform test, against mock providers) of each root that has a tests folder. One target, because validate and test both run terraform init in the same root directories, and concurrent inits corrupt .terraform and the lock file. Part of lint-code. Requires terraform on PATH and downloads the providers, so it needs network access.

options.command: for module in openrouter github linode organizzolini; do (cd $module && terraform init -input=false -backend=false && terraform validate && if [ -d tests ]; then terraform test; fi) || exit 1; done

tflint.description: Lint the OpenRouter, GitHub, Linode, and Organizzolini Terraform roots with tflint and its bundled terraform ruleset (preset all). Each root uses its own .tflint.hcl when it has one, otherwise terraform/.tflint.hcl. The ruleset ships inside the pinned tflint binary, so there is no plugin download and no `tflint --init`, and nothing touches .terraform, so it may run beside the terraform targets. The stale root main.tf is not listed and is never scanned. Part of lint-code. Requires tflint on PATH.

options.command: for root in openrouter github linode organizzolini; do (cd $root && c=../.tflint.hcl; [ -f .tflint.hcl ] && c=.tflint.hcl; tflint --config $c) || exit 1; done

trivy-config.description: Scan Terraform infrastructure code and the rendered Helm manifests (helm-render) for misconfigurations using Trivy, both at CRITICAL and HIGH severity. Identical to what the Secure check runs, so a local run reproduces CI exactly. Requires trivy and helm on PATH (the devcontainer installs trivy; otherwise `brew install trivy`).

options.command: trivy config {projectRoot}/terraform --format table --severity CRITICAL,HIGH --exit-code 1 --ignorefile configuration/security/trivyignore && trivy config dist/infrastructure/helm-render --format table --severity CRITICAL,HIGH --exit-code 1 --ignorefile configuration/security/trivyignore
